title: Abba Yudan of Tzaidan, a Tanna

paragraphs: He testified to a ruling in Rabbi Eliezer’s name, as in [Tosefta Oholot, chapter 18](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Oholot.18.3). [Yevamot 122a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.122a.3) cites his testimony that a woman may remarry on the basis of a gentile speaking incidentally. In the Mekhilta of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, printed in HaPeles, year 3, page 707, Abba Yudan of Tzaidan says in Rabban Gamliel’s name: “From where do we learn that a person should not say, ‘I am unworthy to pray for the Temple’?” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites the HaPeles printing, year 3, page 707, for the opening of the Temple-prayer teaching.

The linked Tosefta gives Abba Yudan reporting in Rabbi Eliezer’s name. The Bavli names him in an account of remarriage following an incidental report. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1739&lang=en) records both references.
